entities.name: Detach procedure
entities.description: UE-initiated detach procedure for EPS/IMSI detach types including switch off, EPS detach, IMSI detach, and combined EPS/IMSI detach.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate detach procedure. Contains Detach type IE.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message expected from network to complete detach procedure.

entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: IE indicating detach cause: switch off, EPS detach, IMSI detach, combined EPS/IMSI detach, or re-attach required.

entities.name: T3421
entities.description: Timer used in detach procedure for retransmission of DETACH REQUEST. Stopped on procedure completion or abortion.

entities.name: EMM-NULL
entities.description: State entered when detach is due to disabling of EPS services.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State entered after EPS detach or combined EPS/IMSI detach.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: State entered after IMSI detach procedure.

entities.name: MM-NULL
entities.description: State entered after IMSI detach or combined EPS/IMSI detach.

entities.name: Access barred for originating signalling
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate access barring for originating signalling, preventing detach procedure start.

entities.name: Lower layer failure or NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Condition where NAS signalling connection fails or is released before DETACH ACCEPT reception.

entities.name: TAI change during detach
entities.description: Condition where UE detects current TAI not in stored TAI list during detach procedure.

entities.name: Local detach
entities.description: UE behavior to locally detach without network signaling, e.g., when access barred or TAI change occurs for switch off/USIM removal.

relations.description: Detach procedure includes sending DETACH REQUEST message.
DETACH REQUEST message contains Detach type IE.
Detach procedure starts timer T3421 for retransmission.
Detach procedure resets and restarts T3421 on first four expiries.
Detach procedure stops T3421 on completion or abortion.
Access barred condition prevents detach procedure start.
Lower layer failure with detach due to disabling EPS services establishes EMM-NULL state.
Lower layer failure with EPS detach establishes EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Lower layer failure with IMSI detach establishes EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
TAI change with USIM removal or switch off establishes local detach behavior.
TAI change with USIM removal or switch off establishes EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
